title: Serde drops error source information when deserializing using try_from
author: axoking
body_preview: When using a custom type and `#[serde(try_from = "..."]`, errors that the `try_from` call throws are not forwarded correctly. Instead, they are converted into strings with no control about how the conversion behaves, and the original error is dropped instead of saving it as a source. title: MapKey::deserialize_bool parses a key from a UTF-8 continuation byte, building an invalid &str in safe code
author: mblauberg
body_preview: `MapKey::deserialize_bool` consumes the key's first byte with `next_char()` and, when it is neither `t` nor `f`, calls `read.parse_str()` from the following byte. For a key that starts with a multi-byte character, parsing therefore starts at a UTF-8 continuation byte, and `StrRead::parse_str` builds a `&str` with `from_utf8_unchecked` over bytes that are not valid UTF-8.
